nodes.description: ChainLinkInterface state variable holding the ETH/USD aggregator address 0x5f4eC3Df9cbd43714FE2740f5E3616155c5b8419 in contract Basic.
internal pure helper in Basic that converts a bytes buffer into a uint256 using inline assembly mload(add(_bytes,0x20)).
bytes memory parameter of toUint256; raw return data of a staticcall is passed here.
Inline assembly mload(add(_bytes,0x20)) reads the first 32 bytes of unvalidated external return data without length or value checks.
public view function of Resolver that loops over caller-supplied price feed addresses and returns PriceData for ETH/USD and every token feed.
address[] memory parameter of getPrices; fully attacker-controlled list of contract addresses used as staticcall targets.
PriceData[] memory array populated per price feed with price, decimals and status.
PriceData memory returned for the hardcoded ethUsdPriceFeed aggregator.
uint loop counter bounded by priceFeeds.length.
Low-level staticcall of latestAnswer() on the attacker-supplied address priceFeeds[i]; target and returned data are not trusted or validated.
Low-level staticcall of decimals() on the attacker-supplied address priceFeeds[i].
Low-level staticcall of latestAnswer() on the hardcoded ethUsdPriceFeed aggregator.
Low-level staticcall of decimals() on the hardcoded ethUsdPriceFeed aggregator.
bool success flag returned by the latestAnswer() staticcall for feed i.
bytes return data of the latestAnswer() staticcall for feed i, later interpreted as a uint256.
bool success flag returned by the decimals() staticcall for feed i.
bytes return data of the decimals() staticcall for feed i, later interpreted as a uint256.
bool success flag of the latestAnswer() staticcall on ethUsdPriceFeed.
bytes return data of the latestAnswer() staticcall on ethUsdPriceFeed.
bool success flag of the decimals() staticcall on ethUsdPriceFeed.
bytes return data of the decimals() staticcall on ethUsdPriceFeed.
constant string state variable 'ChainLink-Aggregator-Resolver-v1' on the derived contract.

edges.reason: The _bytes parameter is the buffer consumed by the inline assembly mload in toUint256.
The assembly mload unsafe operation executes inside the toUint256 function body.
priceFeeds.length determines the loop bound of the counter i in getPrices.
Attacker-supplied address priceFeeds[i] is used directly as the target of the low-level staticcall latestAnswer() with no allowlist check.
Attacker-supplied address priceFeeds[i] is used directly as the target of the low-level staticcall decimals() with no allowlist check.
The loop counter i selects which priceFeeds[i] entry the staticcall loop iteration handles.
getPrices performs the staticcall on priceFeeds[i] inside its for loop.
getPrices performs the decimals staticcall on priceFeeds[i] inside its for loop.
priceStatus receives the boolean success flag of the latestAnswer() staticcall.
priceData receives the raw bytes returned by the latestAnswer() staticcall.
decimalstatus receives the boolean success flag of the decimals() staticcall.
decimalsData receives the raw bytes returned by the decimals() staticcall.
The state variable ethUsdPriceFeed is the target of the latestAnswer() staticcall.
The state variable ethUsdPriceFeed is the target of the decimals() staticcall.
ethPriceStatus receives the success flag of the ethUsdPriceFeed latestAnswer() staticcall.
ethPriceData receives the raw bytes of the ethUsdPriceFeed latestAnswer() staticcall.
ethDecimalstatus receives the success flag of the ethUsdPriceFeed decimals() staticcall.
ethDecimalsData receives the raw bytes of the ethUsdPriceFeed decimals() staticcall.
priceData is converted through toUint256 and stored into tokensPriceInETH[i].price.
decimalsData is converted through toUint256 and stored into tokensPriceInETH[i].decimals.
ethPriceData is converted through toUint256 and stored into ethPriceInUsd.price.
ethDecimalsData is converted through toUint256 and stored into ethPriceInUsd.decimals.
getPrices calls the inherited internal helper toUint256 to decode staticcall return data.
getPrices allocates and writes the returned tokensPriceInETH array.
getPrices assigns the returned ethPriceInUsd struct before returning.

normalization_plan.reason: The ephemeral bytes parameter only exists to feed the inline assembly mload, so it can be folded into that unsafe operation.
The parameter is an externally controlled address array whose only meaningful use is as the low-level staticcall target.
Local return array is entirely scoped to and produced by the getPrices function.
Local return struct is entirely scoped to and produced by the getPrices function.
Loop index counter is a temporary local used only inside the getPrices loop.
Success flag is a direct temporary result of the latestAnswer() staticcall.
Raw return bytes are a direct temporary result of the latestAnswer() staticcall.
Success flag is a direct temporary result of the decimals() staticcall.
Raw return bytes are a direct temporary result of the decimals() staticcall.
Success flag is a direct temporary result of the ethUsdPriceFeed latestAnswer() staticcall.
Raw return bytes are a direct temporary result of the ethUsdPriceFeed latestAnswer() staticcall.
Success flag is a direct temporary result of the ethUsdPriceFeed decimals() staticcall.
Raw return bytes are a direct temporary result of the ethUsdPriceFeed decimals() staticcall.
